notes.title: Chess Mess 0.8.4b beta is now live!
notes.notes:
[h2]WHAT'S NEW[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added "exhaustion" mechanic in an effort to discourage cheesing with one or two pieces for the whole game.[list]
[*]Exhausted pieces have their multiplier and capture value halved.
[*]Exhausted pieces who continued to be used will become [i]deeply exhausted[/i] and will be unable to move for ~6 turns
[*]Added tutorials for exhaustion mechanic.
[*]Added a new font for the body text.
[*]Started work on refining font sizes and button proportions.
[*]Added new curse cards: Paralysis and Attrition
[/list]

[h2]TUTORIALS[/h2]

[list]
[*]Resolved issue with tutorials triggering twice in some instances
[*]Resolved issue with modal boxes and tutorial windows appearing offscreen on certain resolutions/aspect ratios
[*]Added new introduction tutorial that clarifies you're in control of both colors
[*]Re-wrote some tutorials for clarity
[*]Moved "Reset Tutorials" option to Settings -> Gameplay
[/list]

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]

[list]
[*]Resolved issue with selections/movement actions causing spooky action at a distance
[/list]

[h2]DAILY SEED[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added daily leaderboard score submissions to the client
[*]Added leaderboard fetching for current player
[*]Added leaderboard presentation for current player
[/list]

[h2]AUDIO[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added "CHESS AMP" music player[list]
[*]Started working on playlist
[/list]

[*]Added new song "System of a Crown" by artist Two Feet Deep
[*]Added new song "Fay of Summer" by artist Two Feet Deep
[*]Updated some sound effects
[*]Resolved issue with UI buttons not playing their sfx
[/list]

[h2]MISC[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added new Credits scene (found in Settings)
[*]Resolved issue where certain themes would fail to apply accent colors/button colors to UI elements
[*]Fixed piece display issue where pieces would appear as pawns until they had a color set
[*]The King will now always animate His movement regardless of if the player has disabled piece movement animation. This is to make the King's movement more obvious.
[/list]

[h2]BALANCING[/h2]

[list]
[*]Swapped the Rook's (2.25) and the Knight's (1.25) multipliers to 1.25 and 2.25 respectively.
[*]Re-enabled grace moves after the player runs out of moves. (If there's a King in the game, it will amble around)
[*]Nerfed pawn promotion point values.
[*]Re-worked how promotion multipliers/values are calculated[list]
[*]Updated point value screen to reflect new values
[*]Updated point value screen to use current piece theme
[/list]

notes.title: Chess Mess beta 0.8.3b fixes
notes.notes:
The latest Chess Mess update (0.8.3b) is here. It includes a bunch of small fixes that improve the overall gameplay experience.

[list]
[*] Enhanced the game's stability on Steam Deck.
[*] Refined the focus experience.
[*] Updated the game board to wrap selection of columns and rows.
[*] Implemented keyboard input. Most of the game is playable with just arrow keys and the enter key. Notable exceptions include:
  [list]
    [*] Card selection screen
    [*] Card slot selection
    [*] Options menu
    [*] Tutorials
    [*] Hints
  [/list]
[*] Enabled native touchscreen support
[*] Exported save data and preferences to external files that can be synced with Steam Cloud (WIP)
[*] This keyboard implementation lays the groundwork for gamepad input as well. Standard Xbox and DualSense controllers should work, but this is considered unstable and not guaranteed.
[*] Disabled the enableSteamOverlay function on Deck as this was causing the game to crash in Gamescope and it's not needed anyway.
  [list]
    [*] Note that the Steam Overlay is currently broken on Desktop. We're working to resolve this issue.
  [/list]
[/list]
